_comment: What ships, where it comes from, and what it scored. 'seg_custom' checkpoints are re-exported to a stock ultralytics class because they were trained through train_seg.py and are otherwise unloadable without this repo. 'seg_stock' and 'dino' are already portable and are copied with a checksum.

entries.name: seg baseline (contractual)
entries.config: yolov8x-seg, COCO init, 100 epochs, imgsz 640, batch 16, seed 42, deterministic

entries.name: seg method, seed 42
entries.role: DELIVERABLE - the model that beats the baseline
entries.config: yolov8x-seg, COCO init, 30 epochs, imgsz 1280, batch 2, seed 42, no class weighting, no boundary term

entries.name: seg ablation reference
entries.role: the 50-epoch reference every ablation arm is measured against
entries.config: yolov8x-seg, COCO init, 50 epochs, imgsz 640, batch 8, seed 42

entries.name: detection baseline (DINO-DETR)
entries.config: DINO 4-scale, ResNet-50, COCO checkpoint0033 init, 31 classes, 12 epochs, batch 2, seed 42

entries.name: detection cRT arm
entries.role: only detection arm above baseline on test (+0.53 pp), but 98 percent of the gain is one class with 2 test instances
entries.config: baseline with the classifier retrained on class-balanced data, backbone frozen

entries.name: detection D4 arm
entries.role: frequency-aware denoising only; the only frozen-matrix arm above baseline on validation (+0.08 pp, inside noise)

entries.name: detection D5 arm (unified, negative)
entries.role: the proposed unified method. Shipped because it is the evidence for the negative result: 6.05 pp below its own baseline with tail AP exactly 0.0000
entries.config: frequency-aware classification loss, Hungarian matching and denoising, tau 1.0
